name: Knowl
description: Persistent repository memory and write gate for OpenClaw.

enabled.label: Knowl Memory
enabled.help: Enable or pause every Knowl hook. When off the gateway keeps running with no memory card, no write gate and no capture.

gateDeadlineMs.label: Write Gate Deadline (ms)
gateDeadlineMs.help: How long the write gate waits for Knowl before allowing the tool call anyway. Default 5000. Capped below OpenClaw's 15s before_tool_call budget on purpose: that budget is FAIL-CLOSED, so a Knowl that hangs past it would block your write. Hitting this deadline allows the call instead.

observerDeadlineMs.label: Observer Deadline (ms)
observerDeadlineMs.help: Budget for the non-blocking hooks: capture after a tool call, and the checkpoint before compaction. Default 10000, held under OpenClaw's 30s per-handler compaction timeout.

recall.label: Recall Card
recall.help: Prepend the project orientation card at the start of each turn: bound session, pending handoff, recent decisions. The card is fixed for the session and is never a search built from your prompt.

writeGate.label: Write Gate
writeGate.help: Let Knowl refuse a write that contradicts recorded project knowledge. Applies to exec, apply_patch and spawn_agent. A refusal carries its reason back to the model.

impactCard.label: Impact Card
impactCard.help: After a file is written, append what Knowl knows about that file to the tool result, so the model sees it in the same turn rather than the next one.
